name: Validating whether a new location is created.
description: Validating whether the location (TB State Building, Sydney, Australia) has been created.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM location
WHERE name = 'TB State Building'
  AND city = 'sydney'
  AND country = 'australia'
  AND active = true;

name: Validating whether the user is updated with the location.
description: Validating whether Joanne is updated with the new location.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM user u
JOIN location l ON u.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Joanne'
  AND u.last_name = 'Simpson'
  AND l.name = 'TB State Building'
  AND l.city = 'sydney'
  AND l.country = 'australia';

name: Validating whether user is assigned to the group.
description: Validating whether Joanne is added to Proactive Case Monitoring_2 group.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM user u
JOIN user_group_member ugm ON u.user_id = ugm.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON g.group_id = ugm.group_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Joanne'
  AND u.last_name = 'Simpson'
  AND g.name = 'Proactive Case Monitoring_2';

name: Validating whether the case is updated.
description: Validating whether case number CS-0000299 has been updated.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM customer_case c
JOIN user u ON c.assigned_to = u.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON c.assignment_group_id = g.group_id
WHERE c.number = 'CS-0000299'
  AND u.first_name = 'Joanne'
  AND u.last_name = 'Simpson'
  AND g.name = 'Proactive Case Monitoring_2'
  AND c.priority = 'critical'
  AND c.escalation = true
  AND c.escalation_reason = 'impact';

name: Validating whether notification has been sent to the user.
description: Validating whether an update notification has been sent to Joanne.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM notification n
JOIN user u ON n.email = u.email
WHERE u.first_name = 'Joanne'
  AND u.last_name = 'Simpson'
  AND n.type = 'update'
  AND n.status = 'success';
